file_title: File:Palace door and lintel-Yoruba (British Museum).jpg
short_title: Olowe of Ise: painted palace doors
location: Palace of the Ogoga of Ikere, Nigeria; British Museum
notes: One of three views of palace doors and lintel carved by Olowe of Ise. The museum documents their commission for the Ogoga of Ikere and later transfer following the 1924 British Empire Exhibition. Compare surviving paint with exposed wood and shadows; this is an early-20th-century work, not ancient sculpture.
